About - Brewery Web AR Experience Platform

Learn about the Brewery Web AR Experience platform - advanced WebXR technology powered by Rust WebAssembly for brewing analytics, audio synthesis, and immersive experiences.

Our platform combines cutting-edge web technologies including WebXR, WebGPU, WebMIDI, WebCodecs, and Rust WebAssembly to deliver high-performance applications for brewing analytics, audio synthesis, frame-accurate timing, and immersive media experiences.

Features include brewing calculations and analytics, WebMIDI audio synthesis, frame-accurate timing for video production, WebCodecs video processing, WebXR media players, and immersive AR experiences.

Built with React Three Fiber, TypeScript, and a shared Rust WebAssembly foundation for optimal performance across all modules.
